profile.name: Hannah Clarke
profile.summary: NMC registered adult staff nurse with 5 years on acute surgical wards. Calm under pressure, with strong communication skills.

descriptions: Delivered person-centred care for 6-8 post-operative patients per shift on a 28-bed surgical ward
Administered oral and IV medications, including IV therapy via central lines, with zero medication errors in the 2023 audit
Performed wound care and post-operative observations using NEWS2, escalating deteriorating patients within 15 minutes

Coordinated discharge planning for complex surgical patients by working with physiotherapists, occupational therapists, social workers and families in daily multidisciplinary team huddles, which reduced delayed discharges on the ward by roughly 20% over one year and noticeably improved the patient feedback we received
Kept accurate records in the electronic patient record (EPR) system on every shift
Mentored 10 student nurses through their surgical placements
Led ward infection prevention and control audits, keeping hand hygiene compliance above 95%
BLS, ALS, IV cannulation, NEWS2, Lorenzo EPR
